items.title: Ellen Rowe interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 2, 2024
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] This is a Thad Jones arrangement... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, nice.

ctx.x: Yeah. No it’s — I don’t do it a lot but yeah every so often I do and it’s fun to see that you don’t necessarily have to put in days of angst and labor to come up with a nice tune that people like to play, so —
Have you transitioned from — I have a little prop here. This is a Thad Jones arrangement, a small group arrangement for Joe Williams.
